section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1997
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA .997 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 2.8.5 From the above figures it is observed that significant number of female victims had ensured that the means adopted by them results in successful termination of life. This inference is strengthened by the fact that more female victims resorted to self immolation (71.3%), drowning (46.9%) and sleeping pills (43.1%). In all the States & Uts, quite a higher number of females committed suicide by self immolation.
